title: Lost Luggage
paragraphs: Di tengah penerbangan lanjutan menuju rumah, Zahra menyadari dengan kekhawatiran yang meningkat bahwa kopernya tidak ikut dipindahkan ke pesawat kedua, artinya koper itu mungkin masih tertinggal di bandara sebelumnya.

Di meja kedatangan, ia dengan tenang menjelaskan situasinya kepada staf maskapai, yang meyakinkannya bahwa tasnya akan tiba pada penerbangan berikutnya dan dikirim langsung ke alamatnya dalam waktu dua hari.

Sambil menunggu, Zahra harus meminjam pakaian dari saudarinya dan membeli kembali beberapa barang dasar, yang sedikit menjengkelkan tapi jauh dari bencana dibandingkan apa yang awalnya ia khawatirkan.

Ketika koper itu akhirnya tiba tepat seperti yang dijanjikan, Zahra menyadari bahwa tetap tenang dan sabar selama proses itu membuat seluruh situasi jauh lebih mudah dikelola dibandingkan jika ia panik.
answerKey: Halfway through her connecting flight home, Zahra realized with growing worry that her suitcase had not been transferred to the second plane, meaning it was probably still sitting somewhere in the previous airport. At the arrivals desk, she calmly explained the situation to the airline staff, who assured her the bag would arrive on the next available flight and be delivered directly to her address within two days. While waiting, Zahra had to borrow clothes from her sister and repurchase a few basic items, which was mildly frustrating but far from a disaster compared to what she had originally feared might happen. When the suitcase finally arrived exactly as promised, Zahra realized that staying calm and patient throughout the process had made the whole situation far easier to manage than panicking would have.
